cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: an indoor mushroom farm — wooden log stacks sprouting mushrooms, a misting hose, shelving trays and a work lamp
cuts.scene: she is a grower sitting upright on a stool, resting between harvest rounds and planning the next tray
cuts.outfit: a mushroom farmer look fitted to her body — a short rubber apron over a fitted tank top and short shorts with boots, bare shoulders and legs, a mushroom-cap brooch on her bib
